name: ncurator
description: Local-first AI workspace for documents, research, and task execution
author: NCurator

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json --composite false && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.web.json --composite false
scripts.test:ai:human:mock-llm: node scripts/test/workflow.mjs --domain ai --suite human --group mock-llm --type backend
scripts.test:ai:human:live: node scripts/test/workflow.mjs --domain ai --suite human --group live --type backend
scripts.test:terminal: node scripts/build/native/node-pty.mjs ensure node && vitest run --config vitest.backend.config.mts tests/case/unit/ai/terminal-session-manager.test.ts tests/case/unit/ai/terminal-protocol.test.ts tests/case/unit/ai/terminal-platform-adapter.test.ts tests/case/unit/ai/terminal-command-policy.test.ts
scripts.test:update: pnpm run test:update:backend && pnpm run test:update:e2e
scripts.test:update:e2e: node scripts/test/workflow.mjs --domain workbench --type e2e --case sidebar-app-update --case database-version-update-required --target source
scripts.test:workbench:provider-matrix: node scripts/test/workflow.mjs --domain workbench --type e2e --target source --case live-preset-provider-smoke
scripts.test:workbench:wps-office: node scripts/test/workflow.mjs --domain workbench --type e2e --target source --case wps-office-reload-on-write-and-revert
scripts.dev: node scripts/build/native/better-sqlite3.mjs ensure electron && node scripts/build/native/node-pty.mjs ensure electron && node scripts/build/sidecar/ensure.mjs && electron-vite dev
scripts.dev:no-sidecar: node scripts/build/native/better-sqlite3.mjs ensure electron && node scripts/build/native/node-pty.mjs ensure electron && electron-vite dev
scripts.build: node scripts/build/native/better-sqlite3.mjs ensure node && node scripts/build/native/node-pty.mjs ensure node && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json --composite false && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.web.json --composite false && node scripts/build/sidecar/build.mjs && node scripts/build/vditor-assets.mjs && node scripts/build/native/better-sqlite3.mjs export-electron-resource && electron-vite build && node scripts/build/runtime/verify-bundles.mjs && node scripts/build/native/node-pty.mjs ensure electron && node scripts/build/package/prepare-stage.mjs
scripts.build:unpack: pnpm run build && electron-builder --dir && pnpm run package:audit
scripts.build:win: node scripts/build/native/electron-builder-windows.mjs && pnpm run build && electron-builder --win --x64 --publish never && pnpm run package:audit
scripts.build:mac:arm64: pnpm run build && electron-builder --mac --arm64 --publish never && pnpm run package:audit
scripts.build:mac:release:arm64: pnpm run build && electron-builder --mac --arm64 --publish never --config.forceCodeSigning=true && pnpm run package:audit
scripts.native:status: node scripts/build/native/better-sqlite3.mjs status && node scripts/build/native/node-pty.mjs status
scripts.native:prepare: node scripts/build/native/better-sqlite3.mjs prepare && node scripts/build/native/node-pty.mjs prepare
scripts.native:clean: node scripts/build/native/better-sqlite3.mjs clean && node scripts/build/native/node-pty.mjs clean
